status: Implemented and verified in v48; see research/carrier-checkpoint.json
scope: Migrate existing operations to one exact activation-carrier contract before adding any remaining character mechanic
CPU: Provide one active-carrier resolver using the nested activation context, with explicit carrier support for numerical continuations and cold storage initialization. Require exact object membership in the active set; do not silently fall back to first matching definition.
Deliver protection callbacks with the same lexical carrier context as ordinary callbacks, restoring it after nested notifications and exceptions.
Change shield/decoy, storage, healing charge, damage registration and maximum-HP registration to update only that carrier.

Replace the pinned activation's late numerical next-instance lookups with checked exact-carrier bindings. Updating registration alone would still leave damage-cap and maximum-HP arithmetic attached to the wrong instance.
Keep lazy storage initialization explicit for the particular live carrier; do not initialize or refresh sibling instances.
Preserve each operation's declared snapshot, refresh, expiry and event phase. Do not use this identity migration to reorder unrelated effects.
GPU: Declare current_instance for all registered activation operations after their CPU numerical paths are corrected. Generate dispatch from the catalog.
Validate slot and entry generation on delayed parent continuations. A removed parent's continuation must not attach to a replacement in the same slot.
Use the remaining captured recipients for resource creation and HP grants after nested removal; preserve ordered notification delivery.
Retain distinct semantics for stack initialization and normal activation, matching each operation's independent contract rather than applying copy-specific behavior globally.
verification_without_duplicates: Use one table-driven carrier-contract witness for all applicable existing operations: two recipient sets, refresh the second, assert the first's state is unchanged and only the second is registered/updated.
Reuse existing independent quantity and lifecycle comparators for each family instead of creating another copy of its damage/HP formula tests.
Add only missing order distinctions: nested removal, slot replacement and protection-event observation of initialized resources.
Run new witnesses first in one full native suite because the shared executor changes; keep exact comparator/input/backend result reuse.
Check the portable backend on the shared identity/order representatives rather than repeating every character squad.
not_claimed: Identity and existing numerical regressions pass on native and portable GPU. This does not prove every in-game effect or complete all-character support.
